pairs.target: yú wān xiānlù chūlái de búshì shù , shì yìpái xiàng shuǐ lǐ shēnchū de mùjià .
pairs.english: Elmbay first showed itself not as trees, but as a row of wooden racks extending over the water.
pairs.hanzi: 榆湾先露出来的不是树，是一排向水里伸出的木架。

pairs.target: dìèrtiān xiàwǔ , chuán hái méi kàoàn , tǎ wéi biàn kànjiàn jiàshàng liàngzhe chéngpiàn fāliàng de dōngxī . yuǎn kàn xiàng báo jīnshǔ , jìn xiē cái kànchū shì pōukāi de yú .
pairs.english: On the second afternoon, before docking, Tavi saw sheets of shining things drying on racks. Thin metal from a distance, split fish when closer.
pairs.hanzi: 第二天下午，船还没靠岸，塔维便看见架上晾着成片发亮的东西。远看像薄金属，近些才看出是剖开的鱼。

pairs.target: ànbiān de fēngdài zhe xiánwèi , hémiàn què réng húnhuáng , bìng bú xiàng tā tōutōu xiǎng guò de nàyàng , dào le yuǎnchù , shuǐ jiù gāi huàn yìzhǒng yánsè .
pairs.english: The shore wind tasted salty, but the river stayed muddy yellow. Unlike his private imaginings, distant water hadn't changed its color.
pairs.hanzi: 岸边的风带着咸味，河面却仍浑黄，并不像他偷偷想过的那样，到了远处，水就该换一种颜色。

pairs.target: bǔguō de nǚrén tíqǐ kuāng , jiào tā bié zuò zhe kàn le , xiàchuán de rén yì duō , bāo huì bèi jǐ dào kànbújiàn . tā gǎnjǐn bǎ bùtào àn zài xiōngkǒu , bèi hǎo zìjǐ de dài .
pairs.english: The pot mender lifted her basket and told him not to sit staring: once people disembarked, his bag would be lost in the crush. He pressed his cloth sleeve to his chest and shouldered his bag.
pairs.hanzi: 补锅的女人提起筐，叫他别坐着看了，下船的人一多，包会被挤到看不见。他赶紧把布套按在胸口，背好自己的袋。

pairs.target: kè bù de lù fēnchéng liǎngcéng , xiàmiàn xièhuò , shàngmiàn zǒu rén . jǐmíng tiāofū zhèng yǔ kàn pái de rén zhēng , chē míngmíng yǐ zài kòngdì děng zhe , wèishénme hái bùxǔ táiguòqù .
pairs.english: The landing had two levels, freight below and pedestrians above. Porters argued with the sign keeper: the cart was already waiting in the clearing, so why couldn't they carry things over?
pairs.hanzi: 客埠的路分成两层，下面卸货，上面走人。几名挑夫正与看牌的人争，车明明已在空地等着，为什么还不许抬过去。

pairs.target: kàn pái de rén bǎ mù chǐ zhǐxiàng yíkuài liúkōng de pōdào , shuō lìng yíchù cāng xíng fù le zhè bàn kè de zhuǎnyùn wèi , děng tāmen chē zǒu . tiāofū mà bàn kè gòu tā pǎo liǎngtàng , réng jiāng dànzi fàngdào bù dǎnglù de biānshàng .
pairs.english: The keeper pointed a wooden rule at a clear ramp: another warehouse had paid for this short transfer slot; wait until its cart left. A porter swore he could make two trips in that time, but set his load out of the way.
pairs.hanzi: 看牌的人把木尺指向一块留空的坡道，说另一处仓行付了这半刻的转运位，等他们车走。挑夫骂半刻够他跑两趟，仍将担子放到不挡路的边上。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi ràoguòqù , méiyǒu zhīdào shuí zuìhòu huì ràngbù . nà zhēng shēng hěnkuài bèi mài fàn , jiào chē hé chuánshàng cuī bān de shēngyīn gàizhù , chéng méiyǒu yīnwèi lái le yígèdìyīcì dào de rén , jiù tíngxiàlái tì tā mànmàn jiǎng míngbái .
pairs.english: Tavi walked round, never learning who would yield. Food sellers, cart calls and unloading shouts soon drowned the argument; the city didn't stop to explain itself slowly for one first-time visitor.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维绕过去，没有知道谁最后会让步。那争声很快被卖饭、叫车和船上催搬的声音盖住，城没有因为来了一个第一次到的人，就停下来替他慢慢讲明白。

pairs.target: tā zhàozhe mǎtóu biān de zhùsù pái zhǎodào sānwǎn kèzhàn . ménliǎn bú dà , hòuyuàn què fēnchū liǎngpái fáng , shí dìshàng bǎi zhe gāng xǐ guò de shuǐpén .
pairs.english: Following the lodging sign by the landing, he found Three Bowls Inn. A small frontage opened onto two rows of rooms in the rear yard, freshly washed basins on the stone floor.
pairs.hanzi: 他照着码头边的住宿牌找到三碗客栈。门脸不大，后院却分出两排房，石地上摆着刚洗过的水盆。

pairs.target: nǚ zhǎngguì gěi tā kàn pùwèi hé suǒ xiāng , jià zhào pái shàng xiě de , méiyǒu lìngwài suàn yífèn chūláizhàdào de qián . tā bǎ huíchéng rìqī shuō qīng , fù le liǎngyè fángqián , cái zhēnzhèng gǎn jiāng bāo cóng jiānshàng xièxiàlái .
pairs.english: The innkeeper showed his berth and lockbox, charging the posted price with no newcomer surcharge. He explained his return date and paid for two nights before truly daring to unload his bag.
pairs.hanzi: 女掌柜给他看铺位和锁箱，价照牌上写的，没有另外算一份初来乍到的钱。他把回程日期说清，付了两夜房钱，才真正敢将包从肩上卸下来。

pairs.target: yìmíng sòng chuángdān de gūniáng bāng tā bǎ chuāng tuīkāi , shuō yèlǐ kào shuǐ huì liáng , chuāng gōu yào guà hǎo . tā wèn tā , zhèlǐ shìbushì yǒu hěnduō yúshù .
pairs.english: A girl delivering sheets helped open his window, saying waterside nights were cool and the hook must be fastened. He asked whether there were many elms here.
pairs.hanzi: 一名送床单的姑娘帮他把窗推开，说夜里靠水会凉，窗钩要挂好。他问她，这里是不是有很多榆树。

pairs.target: tā xiǎng le yíxià , shuō wài dī yǒu , jiē lǐ jiù nàme jǐkē , qùnián hái kǎn le yìkē huài de . yòu wèn tā wèishénme dìyījù búshì wèn rèshuǐ . tā xiào , shuō yǒurén jiào tā dào le kànkàn .
pairs.english: She considered: on the outer embankment, yes; only a few in the streets, one rotten tree cut down last year. Why hadn't he asked about hot water first? He laughed: someone had told him to look when he arrived.
pairs.hanzi: 她想了一下，说外堤有，街里就那么几棵，去年还砍了一棵坏的。又问他为什么第一句不是问热水。他笑，说有人叫他到了看看。

pairs.target: " nà nǐ hái dé wǎng wài dī zǒu . zài chuāng lǐ kàn , zhǐnéng kànjiàn wǒjiā shài pén . "
pairs.english: “Then you will have to walk to the outer embankment. From this window, you only see our drying basins.”
pairs.hanzi: “那你还得往外堤走。在窗里看，只能看见我家晒盆。”

pairs.target: gūniáng chūmén hòu , tā bǎ chuángdān zhǎnkāi , chuáng xià sǎo dé gānjìng , xiāng suǒ yě néng zhuǎn .
pairs.english: After she left he spread the sheet; beneath the bed was swept clean and the lock turned properly.
pairs.hanzi: 姑娘出门后，他把床单展开，床下扫得干净，箱锁也能转。

pairs.target: tā zài suíshēn de wàichū lián shàng bǔ hào kèzhàn míngzì , lìng xiě yìzhāng gěi sè lā : chuán dào le , zhùchù dìng le , huí chuán réng zhào yuán piào . xiě wán xiǎng tiāndiǎn biéde , yòu bú yuàn bǎ yǎnqián suǒyǒu dōngxī dōu jǐchéng yíchuàn dìmíng , biàn zhī jiā le jù , yú jià yuǎn kàn xiàng tiě .
pairs.english: He added the inn's name to his carried itinerary and wrote Sela: arrived, lodging settled, return boat unchanged. Wanting more than a string of place names, he added only that the fish racks looked like iron from afar.
pairs.hanzi: 他在随身的外出联上补好客栈名字，另写一张给瑟拉：船到了，住处定了，回船仍照原票。写完想添点别的，又不愿把眼前所有东西都挤成一串地名，便只加了句，鱼架远看像铁。

pairs.target: kè bù chuánxìn chù hái wèishōu chuāng , tā zǒu huíqù , jiāng zhǐ jiāogěi wǎng tóng jiē zhuǎn xìn de rén , fù guò qián , cái kāishǐ zhǎo míngzǎo qù xī wài huòchǎng de chē .
pairs.english: The landing's message office was still open. He gave his note to the Copperstep forwarding clerk and paid, then sought tomorrow's transport to the western outer freight yard.
pairs.hanzi: 客埠传信处还未收窗，他走回去，将纸交给往铜阶转信的人，付过钱，才开始找明早去西外货场的车。

pairs.target: wèn dào dìèrgè rén shí , tā xiǎnxiē yòu shuōchū fú lán de jiù dìzhǐ . lín chūkǒu gǎichéng xiànzài de jiùhuò chǎngwài yán , duìfāng fǎnér diǎntóu , shuō nà yídài rújīn yǒu rǎnbù de yuànzi , zǎochē sòng gōngrén guòqù , kěyǐ zài chàkǒu xià .
pairs.english: Asking a second person, he almost gave Fulan's old address, then changed it to the present old freight yard edge. The person nodded: dyeing yards now occupied that area; workers' morning carts could drop him at the junction.
pairs.hanzi: 问到第二个人时，他险些又说出芙兰的旧地址。临出口改成现在的旧货场外沿，对方反而点头，说那一带如今有染布的院子，早车送工人过去，可以在岔口下。

pairs.target: chēxíng pái shàng xiě zhe jià , shōuqián de rén ràng tā jì hǎo huíchéng nà yítàng de shíchén , wǎnshàng méi chē bù guī zìjǐ guǎn . tā méiyǒu gēn chē de rén jiǎng xúnzhǎo shuí , zhī bǎ shíchén chāoxiàlái , huíchéng nà lán liú dé hěn xǐngmù .
pairs.english: The cart sign posted the fare; the clerk told him to note the return time, disclaiming responsibility for no evening service. He didn't explain whom he sought, just copied the times with the return column conspicuous.
pairs.hanzi:
车行牌上写着价，收钱的人让他记好回城那一趟的时辰，晚上没车不归自己管。
他没有跟车的人讲寻找谁，只把时辰抄下来，回程那栏留得很醒目。

pairs.target: tiān jiànhēi , jiēshàng réng yǒu xǔduō rén . liǎngjiā mài dēngyóu de diàn miànduìmiàn liàng zhe bùtóng yánsè de dēng , yìjiā ménqián yǒurén bǐjià , lìngyìjiā zhǎngguì mà gébì chān dōngxī , mà wán yòu jiè le rénjiā de chángdèng , gěi lái sònghuò de lǎorén zuò .
pairs.english: As dark fell, the street stayed crowded. Two facing lamp-oil shops lit different-colored lamps; customers compared prices at one while the other proprietor accused his neighbor of adulteration, then borrowed his bench for an elderly deliveryman.
pairs.hanzi: 天渐黑，街上仍有许多人。两家卖灯油的店面对面亮着不同颜色的灯，一家门前有人比价，另一家掌柜骂隔壁掺东西，骂完又借了人家的长凳，给来送货的老人坐。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi zhàn zài pángbiān , hūrán juéde zìjǐ yǐjīng hěnjiǔméi xiǎngqǐ nà fēngxìn le . tā yǒuxiē xīnxū , suíhòu yòu bùxiǎng wèi zhè diǎnxīnxū bǎ yǎnjīng shōuhuí qù .
pairs.english: Standing nearby, Tavi realized he hadn't thought about the letter for some time. He felt guilty, then didn't want that guilt to make him stop looking.
pairs.hanzi:
塔维站在旁边，忽然觉得自己已经很久没想起那封信了。
他有些心虚，随后又不想为这点心虚把眼睛收回去。

pairs.target: sānwǎn kèzhàn ménqián yǒu yìzhū yúshù , zhīyā bèi xiū dé hěn duǎn , mùdèng rào zhe shùgēn bǎi .
pairs.english: An elm stood before Three Bowls Inn, its branches pruned short, wooden benches circling its roots.
pairs.hanzi: 三碗客栈门前有一株榆树，枝丫被修得很短，木凳绕着树根摆。

pairs.target: sòng chuángdān de gūniáng zuòzài nàlǐ xiāo yìgēn zhútiáo , jiàn tā huílái , wèn zhǎodào shù méiyǒu . tā zhǐzhe tā tóushàng , tā tái yǎn , zìjǐ yě xiào le , shuō tiāntiān zhàn zài xiàmiàn , dǎobǎ zhè kē wàng le .
pairs.english: The sheet girl sat shaving a bamboo strip. Seeing him return, she asked if he had found trees. He pointed above her; she looked up and laughed, saying she had forgotten this one though standing beneath it daily.
pairs.hanzi: 送床单的姑娘坐在那里削一根竹条，见他回来，问找到树没有。他指着她头上，她抬眼，自己也笑了，说天天站在下面，倒把这棵忘了。

pairs.target: tā zuò dào dèngzǐ lìngyìtóu , wèn tā biān shénme . yuánlái shì gěi kèfáng huàn huàidiào de chuāng gōu , zhú de piányi , shī guò què róngyì wān . tā xián tā kàn dé tài rènzhēn , bǎ gāng xiāo hǎo de yìgēn sāi gěi tā , ràng tā bāngmáng shìshì , bié zhǐgù zhe dāng xuéwèn kàn .
pairs.english: He sat at the other end and asked what she made: replacement window hooks for guest rooms. Bamboo was cheap but bent when wet. Finding him too intent, she handed him the finished one to test, instead of just studying it.
pairs.hanzi: 他坐到凳子另一头，问她编什么。原来是给客房换坏掉的窗钩，竹的便宜，湿过却容易弯。她嫌他看得太认真，把刚削好的一根塞给他，让他帮忙试试，别只顾着当学问看。

pairs.target: tǎ wéi jiēguò lái , zài zìjǐ de chuāng biān shì le liǎnghuí , zhēn yǒu yìdiǎn tài cháng . tā ná huí shù xià , zhǐ gěi tā kàn nǎér dǐngzhù le . gūniáng xiāoduǎn yì jié , jiào tā zài qù . zhècì hé shàng chuāng , gōuzǐ wěnwěn kòuzhù , gébì chuánlái zhùkè yào rèshuǐ de shēngyīn .
pairs.english: Tavi tried it twice at his window: a little too long. He brought it back to show where it caught. She trimmed it and sent him again. This time the window closed and the hook held; next door a guest called for hot water.
pairs.hanzi: 塔维接过来，在自己的窗边试了两回，真有一点太长。他拿回树下，指给她看哪儿顶住了。姑娘削短一截，叫他再去。这次合上窗，钩子稳稳扣住，隔壁传来住客要热水的声音。

pairs.target: tā huídào chuángbiān , bǎ chāo xìn fàngzài zhuōshàng . zhǐ lǐ de jiù yú wān hé chuāngwài de shēngyīn , dìyīcì tóngshí liúzài le tā shēnbiān .
pairs.english: He returned to the bed and put the copied letter on the table. For the first time, old Elmbay on paper and the sounds outside his window stayed beside him together.
pairs.hanzi: 他回到床边，把抄信放在桌上。纸里的旧榆湾和窗外的声音，第一次同时留在了他身边。
